english.note: Use this when the gruesome manner is frightening or horrifying rather than specifically bloody.

examples.english: The monsters appeared gruesomely in the film and kept me awake all night.
examples.traditional: 套戲啲鬼怪恐怖咁現身，嚇到我成晚瞓唔着。
